focus: Initial Project Structure and Build Config

entries.logic: Follows the standard Maven structure: src/main/java for code, src/main/resources for assets, and src/test/java for unit tests.
entries.rationale: Aligns with industry standards, ensuring compatibility with all major Java IDEs and build tools.

entries.logic: Generates a complete pom.xml file using CAT with quoted Heredoc (<<'EOF') to ensure no shell expansion occurs within the XML tags.
entries.rationale: Guarantees that the generated build configuration is bit-identical to the template, preventing injection errors.
